dispatcher.description: User-facing gateway. Calls judge once per request, relays final report. Cannot call specialists.

judge.description: Orchestration brain. Owns delegation loop, calls specialists directly, returns terminal JSON.

low-fixer.description: Simple, low-risk, reversible changes with exact instructions.

medium-fixer.description: Bounded implementation following existing patterns. Runs validation.

deep-fixer.description: Complex implementation of approved architecture. Cross-system changes.

explorer.description: Fast codebase search and pattern matching.

oracle.description: Hard problem solver. Architecture decisions, unclear root cause, security concerns.
